body:
Fixes #19096

Clause-②: no

## What changed

One line of `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (:279), rewritten in place. Net 0 lines (403 / 403, headroom 0); the new line is exactly 120 bytes, the file's `MAX_LINE_BYTES` cap. No other line of the file moved.

Before (`4efb988`, verbatim):

> - 正文行首照抄认领的 `Clause-②:` 行:`Check Changeset` 读正文不读卡,开 PR 那一笔就带上。

After (`fba3bb3`, verbatim):

> - 认领带 `Clause-②:` 行才照抄进正文行首:`Check Changeset` 读正文不读卡;无则零写,⛔ 不自造。

## Why

The old line told every dispatched dev, unconditionally, to copy the claim's `Clause-②:` line into the PR body. Both halves are conditional and the file said so nowhere: a claim may carry no such line (the clause-② flow is the objectstack dual-carrier mechanism), and the reader the rationale names does not exist in objectui. A dev following the unconditional wording either spends a step on a non-existent obligation or, worse, invents the line, and `Check Changeset` reads the body, so an invented declaration would be believed.

The shape is the one the card's triage grading points at (an unconditional clause takes its condition, as :68's landing-repo precedent does) with the PM's pick between the three named shapes: condition on the **claim**, not the repository, and name the reader once, so the line stays true in both repositories without naming either. Evidence that the claim, not the repo, is the right condition: `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs`'s own fixtures (:9306–9320 at `4efb988`) hold objectui claims that carry a `Clause-②:` line (the objectui 7804 rows, the later objectui 7696 row) and one that carries none (the first objectui 7696 row). A repo-conditional line would be false in both directions on that board; a claim-conditional line is true on every row.

The dropped clause 「开 PR 那一笔就带上」 restates :56 (「PR 正文 dev 只写一次,在开 PR 那一笔,⛔ 不 `PATCH`」), so removing it loses no rule; that is how the added negative branch (「无则零写,⛔ 不自造」) is paid for inside the same 120-byte line. No line elsewhere was retired.

## Premise re-verified on the base (`4efb988`, `origin/main` at branch time)

- The reader that makes the line true is `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` (header: 「the dual carrier is asserted by mechanism」, 「the claim comment SELECTED as the carrier」). objectui has none, in its own words: `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` :187 「`scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs`, and this repository has no such file」 and :1959 「⚠️ objectui has no `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` to defer the verdict question」, read at objectui `origin/main` `0c2eb5e`. Controls on the same tree: `ls scripts | wc -l` → 124; `git ls-tree --name-only -r origin/main | grep -ci clause2` → 0.
- The 403 ceiling is pinned by `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (`CEILINGS` row `['.claude/agents/os-dev.md', 403]`, `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`); 14 lines of the file already sit at exactly 120 bytes, none over. The :68 precedent for a one-line repo-conditional clause is 119 bytes.
- `check:pm-skill-id-lint` scans this file with `/#[0-9]{3,}/`; the new line has 0 hits.
- The file's two latest landings (fe36a40 → :285; 87f776b → rule 4 and the label band) did not touch :279.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:os-dev 开发 agent 定义文件里的一行指令改成条件式:认领评论带 `Clause-②:` 行才照抄进 PR 正文行首;没有就不写、⛔ 不自己编一行。只改这一行,净行数 0(403 / 403),行宽恰在 120 字节上限。

**为什么改**:原句是无条件的。objectui 卡的认领评论常常不带这一行,那边也没有读这行的门禁;dev 照做会扑空,更坏的是自己编一行——而 objectstack 这边的 `Check Changeset` 恰恰读正文不读卡,会把编造出来的声明当真。按「认领有没有这一行」取条件,两个仓都成立,且不用点名任何仓;载体检查器自己的 fixture 里 objectui 认领有带的也有不带的,说明按仓取条件在两个方向上都会出错。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:一行改动、无生成物、无 changeset、19 个派生门禁全绿。措辞更紧凑但读者名与理由都保留;去掉的「开 PR 那一笔就带上」已由第 56 行「正文只写一次」覆盖。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:本 PR 属 Tier S(`.claude/**`),由 skills 席在席内达档复核后经队列落地,不需要你点击。若你不认同「按认领取条件」这个形状(另两种:按落地仓取条件、点名双载体的归属车道),在卡上留一句即可。
